rule: The credit team’s rule: the two regions’ false-decline rates stay within 5 points of each other. Then make the fewest wrong decisions overall.

reasons.features: Fields the check may read: every field, all but the region, or neither region nor postcode.
reasons.fix: Count region B’s applicants three times in the fit, so both regions weigh the same.
reasons.bars: One bar per region: approve when the chance of repaying is at least this.
